name: ladder
description: The model ladder: the top model is spent on judgment only. Every prompt is triaged and the session moves down a rung when the top would be wasted, back up when judgment is needed. Ships the /orchestrate conductor skill.

enabled.title: Ladder on
enabled.description: Off, the ladder neither triages nor switches; the policy section and /orchestrate still load.

ceiling.title: Top rung
ceiling.description: The highest tier the ladder may move the session to.

floor.title: Bottom rung
floor.description: The lowest tier the ladder may move the session to. Haiku stays the bulk worker tier for delegation whatever this says.

upSwitch.title: Switch back up
upSwitch.description: On, a prompt that needs the top rung moves the session back up. Each move up re-reads the whole context on the dearer model once.

holdTurns.title: Hold after /model
holdTurns.description: Prompts to honour a model you chose by hand before the ladder resumes.

minTurnsBetweenSwitches.title: Prompts between switches
minTurnsBetweenSwitches.description: Fewest prompts between two ladder moves, so a conversation that alternates does not flap.

minChars.title: Shortest prompt to triage
minChars.description: Shorter prompts (yes, continue, ok) pass through untouched on the current model.

classifier.title: Triage model
classifier.description: The cheap model that labels each prompt; an alias or a full id.
